elements.text:
Existing item	Effect on experimentation / learning	Revision to the plan
P1 Shared board and squad	Positive: exposes queues and different perspectives. Negative: WIP can crowd out learning.	Reserve learning capacity; vary WIP in a documented experiment.
P2 Automated tests	Positive: quick evidence about defects. Negative: teams may treat green tests as complete assurance.	Pair Dev/Test; review escaped defects; add new regression cases.
P3 Release gates and standard tools	Positive: safe experiments and comparable logs. Negative: slow approvals or rigid standards block trials.	Delegate low-risk staging experiments; review gates and accept justified tool exceptions.
P4 Metrics dashboard	Positive: shows trends. Negative: rankings can encourage hiding problems.	Use team outcomes, include sample sizes, and discuss context without blame.

elements.name: table-footnote
elements.text: Culture suitability is unknown. Interviews and observed behavior must test assumption A3.
